Title: Q: LSJ: Undead Persistance and Amaranth

Messages.Author: Robert Goudie
Messages.Body:
Hi L. Scott,

Using the existing ruling on Pulled Fangs as support, I think it should
be OK for a minion who is temporarily being kept from torpor because of
the effect of an Undead Persistance to play an Amaranth. Is this
correct, and if it is, could it be added explicitly to the list of
rulings like the Pulled Fangs instance? Thanks.

Robert

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Robert Goudie wrote:
>
> Using the existing ruling on Pulled Fangs as support, I think it should
> be OK for a minion who is temporarily being kept from torpor because of
> the effect of an Undead Persistance to play an Amaranth. Is this
> correct, and if it is, could it be added explicitly to the list of
> rulings like the Pulled Fangs instance? Thanks.

This is correct. I'll add it to the summary sheet in the form of
a general rule (since it also applies to any card "not usable by
a minion going to torpor").
